Western Region

Western

Follow the coast for beaches and surf, or turn inland toward forest, farms and working towns.

Nzulezu, the stilt village on the Amansuri wetland · Photo: KwesiRaul

Capital

Sekondi-Takoradi

Go for

Surf, rainforest, beaches and cocoa country

Good to know

Coastal towns and inland forest share the same rain-rich landscape.

Worth the trip.

Places in this region people keep coming back to. Not a ranking — a starting point.

  • Nzulezu

    A village built on stilts over the Amansuri wetland, reached by canoe.

    Visit Ghana guide ↗Wikipedia ↗

  • Busua Beach

    Surf lessons, slow afternoons and a walkable beach town.

    Wikipedia ↗

  • Cape Three Points

    The southernmost point of Ghana, with a lighthouse and forest reserve.

    Wikipedia ↗

  • Fort San Antonio, Axim

    A Portuguese fort of 1515, above the sea.

    Visit Ghana guide ↗Wikipedia ↗

  • Ankasa Conservation Area

    Dense rainforest in the far southwest.

    Wikipedia ↗
